findings: Incoming-to-return label difference is exactly two: old successor reaches the attachment vertex, and its successor is the new vertex. This proves actual remoteness including parent arity three and every insertion position.

The segment-parameter equivalence is bidirectional and preserves both closed parameter intervals. The actual inserted tuple and actual incoming and return edges are rewritten to P(j-1)+s*(Pj-P(j-1)) and Pj+epsilon*q+t*(P(j+1)-Pj-epsilon*q). No abstract substitute for the source geometry is used.

Parent G1 gives the nonzero parent turn determinant. Source admissibility gives incoming/q and q/outgoing determinants nonzero. The final theorem consumes the proved local closed-segment criterion and translates both signs to the exact attachment and parent turn definitions.

A single positive radius works for every positive epsilon below it. The intersection equivalence and IsCrossing equivalence have the same loop-sector condition, with the latter obtained using proved remoteness. Genericity of the inserted tuple is not assumed.
